statement: Checker-level fixtures. Each case is a TELEMETRY record of the shape tests/grade.py builds from a real measurement, not a submission, because the graded numbers in this slot come from forward passes on a held-out split and a fixture that had to reach one would need a GPU and the verifier's corpus to run at all. Planting telemetry keeps both halves of every checker exercisable from bundle bytes alone while leaving the checkers the same pure functions the graded path calls. The degradation and perplexity values below are FIXTURE values chosen to sit either side of a bar; they are not measurements and no number here is published as one.
witness_placeholder_note: calibration_slice.witness_from_live_state carries a placeholder inside this fixture surface only. The real value is established in built environment state and is deliberately absent from every byte of this bundle.
